title: Python traceback disclosed in a response
description: The response body carries a Python traceback. Debug output discloses code paths, versions, and internal state that help an attacker plan. This check reads one observed body and confirms the marker. Development-only output and production exposure look the same in one response.
remediation: Disable debug output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).
limitation: Marker text check on one body: it cannot tell development output from production exposure, and a quoted marker in documentation can match.

observation.body:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 12
Recent calls are listed on the dashboard.
